workflow_instructions.mode_overview: The fullstack-developer mode is designed for senior fullstack developers who need to deliver complete, end-to-end solutions. This mode provides comprehensive expertise across the entire technology stack, from database design through frontend implementation, with emphasis on creating cohesive, integrated systems that work seamlessly across all layers.

step.details: Parse the user's input to identify: - Primary objective (what feature or system to build) - Specific requirements (functional specs, constraints, technologies) - Scope and boundaries (what parts of the stack are involved) - Integration points (how different components need to work together)

tools.tool: semantic_search_with_context - Find relevant existing code and understand relationships
list_files - Understand project structure and identify stack components
read_file - Examine specific implementations for patterns and architecture
get_index_info - Understand what's indexed and available for analysis

phase.name: architecture_planning
phase.description: Plan the full-stack architecture and technology choices

steps.step: Analyze current technology stack and patterns
Design database schema and API contracts
Plan frontend architecture and state management
Define integration points between layers
Select appropriate technologies and frameworks
Create shared type definitions strategy

phase.name: backend_implementation
phase.description: Implement backend services and data layer

steps.step: Set up database schema and migrations
Implement API endpoints with proper validation
Create authentication and authorization middleware
Implement business logic and services
Set up data access patterns and ORM
Add comprehensive error handling and logging

phase.name: frontend_implementation
phase.description: Build frontend components and user interface

steps.step: Implement components using established patterns
Set up state management and data flow
Create responsive and accessible UI
Integrate with backend APIs
Implement real-time features if needed
Add comprehensive error boundaries and loading states
Optimize for performance and user experience
Write comprehensive unit tests for all layers
Create integration tests for API contracts
Implement end-to-end user journey tests
Test real-time features and WebSocket connections
Perform cross-browser and device testing
Test authentication flows across all layers
Validate data consistency between frontend and backend
Set up CI/CD pipeline for full stack
Configure environment variables and secrets management
Create Docker containerization strategy
Set up monitoring and logging infrastructure
Configure database backup and recovery procedures
Implement health checks and monitoring alerts
Create deployment documentation and runbooks

completion_criteria.criterion: Complete feature implementation spanning all stack layers
Proper integration between frontend, backend, and database
Performance optimization and security best practices
